questions.question: In $\displaystyle\int_a^b f(x)\,\mathrm{d}x$, what is called the integrand?
How should the integrand be interpreted?
options: It is always the upper integration limit
It is the function being accumulated in an integral
It is always the value of the integral
It is the variable of differentiation only

questions.question: In $\displaystyle\int_0^1 x^2\,\mathrm{d}x$, what is the integrand?
In $\displaystyle\int \,\mathrm{d}x$, what is the integrand?
Which part of an integral influences integrability?
options: The font used for the integral sign
Only the name of the variable

questions.question: Which statement correctly identifies the integrand in both definite and indefinite integrals?
options: In both cases the integrand is the upper limit
In $\int_a^b f(x)\,\mathrm{d}x$ and $\int f(x)\,\mathrm{d}x$, the integrand is $f$
In both cases the integrand is the integral sign
In both cases the integrand is the final value of the integral

questions.question: In $\displaystyle\int_a^b f(x)\,\mathrm{d}x$, what is not the integrand?
In $\displaystyle\int_0^1 (x^2+1)\,\mathrm{d}x$, what is the integrand?
Which mistake does $\displaystyle\int \,\mathrm{d}x$ help prevent?
options: Forgetting that a missing written function can mean the integrand is $1$
Thinking that every integral has integrand $0$
Thinking that the upper limit is always the integrand.
Thinking that indefinite integrals have no integrands

questions.question: Why is the integrand more than a piece of notation?
options: It is always equal to the integral's numerical value
Its properties can influence whether the function is integrable
It determines the notation for infinity
It replaces the domain of a function

questions.question: A student says the integrand of $\displaystyle\int_0^1 x^2\,\mathrm{d}x$ is $[0,1]$. What is the correction?
options: The integrand is $x^2$; $[0,1]$ is the interval of integration
There is no integrand in a definite integral.

questions.question: In $\displaystyle\int f(x)\,\mathrm{d}x$, what is the integrand?
options: In $\displaystyle\int f(x)\,\mathrm{d}x$, the integrand is the integral sign
In $\displaystyle\int f(x)\,\mathrm{d}x$, the integrand is always $x$

questions.question: In an integral, what role does the integrand play?
options: It is the function being accumulated
It is only the integration variable
It is the value of the integral

questions.question: Can an indefinite integral have an integrand?
options: No, only definite integrals have integrands
Only if the integral has upper and lower limits
Yes, in $\int f(x)\,\mathrm{d}x$ the integrand is $f$

questions.question: Which part of $\displaystyle\int_a^b f(x)\,\mathrm{d}x$ is the integrand?
In $\displaystyle\int_0^2 (3x+1)\,\mathrm{d}x$, what is the integrand?
In $\displaystyle\int \sin x\,\mathrm{d}x$, what is the integrand?
In $\displaystyle\int_1^3 5\,\mathrm{d}x$, what is the integrand?
Why do properties of the integrand matter?
options: They influence whether the function is integrable
They determine only the name of the variable
They replace the bounds of integration

questions.question: A student says the integrand of $\displaystyle\int_0^1 x^2\,\mathrm{d}x$ is $\mathrm{d}x$. What is correct?
